cases.why: A proposal naming the pull request that filed it IS checked — by docs.sh, in bash, with the URL pattern inline. Binding it here would put two spellings of one rule across a LANGUAGE boundary, which is worse than the same-language duplication evals/README.md already refuses for the awk filter. The carrier exists and is not this one.
